abstract_sentences.text: We study cross-domain lossy compression, where the encoder observes a degraded source while the decoder reconstructs samples from a distinct target distribution.
The problem is formulated as constrained optimal transport with two constraints on compression rate and classification loss.

evidence.anchor: two constraints on compression rate and classification loss

abstract_sentences.text: With shared common randomness, the one-shot setting reduces to a deterministic transport plan, and we derive closed-form distortion-rate-classification (DRC) and rate-distortion-classification (RDC) tradeoffs for Bernoulli sources under Hamming distortion.

evidence.anchor: one-shot setting reduces to a deterministic transport plan

abstract_sentences.text: In the asymptotic regime, we establish analytic DRC/RDC expressions for Gaussian models under mean-squared error.
The framework is further extended to incorporate perception divergences (Kullback-Leibler and squared Wasserstein), yielding closed-form distortion-rate-perception-classification (DRPC) functions.

To validate the theory, we develop deep end-to-end compression models for super-resolution (MNIST), denoising (SVHN, CIFAR-10, ImageNet, KODAK), and inpainting (SVHN) problems, demonstrating the consistency between the theoretical results and empirical performance.

evidence.anchor: demonstrating the consistency between the theoretical results and empirical performance

abstract_summary.strongest_claim_location: sentence 5–6: closed-form DRPC plus consistency between theory and empirical performance

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把 degraded-to-target restoration 写成 rate/classification-constrained OT coupling；shared randomness 给 one-shot deterministic plan，Bernoulli/Gaussian/DRPC 理论给 closed forms，深度 stochastic autoencoder 用 quantization/entropy/WGAN/CE 近似该约束目标（p.2–9、p.15–30）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留问题定义、Theorem 1–7 主结论、适用分布/失真/感知假设、Figure 3–6、§5.1 relaxed loss 和任务覆盖（p.3–9）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 证明、LP active-set、inverse RDC、Wasserstein branch、架构/优化器/λ、exact rate、inpainting、真实噪声与 comparator 移至 p.15–50；这些内容对复现和公平比较不可省略。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Theorem 1 reduction、Theorem 2/4 active-set branches、Figure 17 theory-vs-empirical overlay、Tables 1–5/11–15 的 rate/quality tradeoff 共同形成从形式对象到实证的可追踪链。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 单条曲线和 aggregate tables 承担多数 empirical claim；没有 seeds、误差/检验、matched-rate comparator，Table 15 无 rate 列却讨论 smaller rate，且深度模型未直接测 pY/H(S|Y) 是否达到理论约束。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 多约束 coupling 论文应在正文并置可解优化、约束到指标的映射、直接机制验证图和可复现 rate/compute 表。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 只适用于边际/约束可明确写出、synthetic coupling 可采样且指标代理与理论对象同构的压缩/恢复任务；非 Gaussian/Bernoulli、标签不可用或训练代理不对应理论 divergence 时应收窄结论。
